subject: ArrTags task 15.2 - Thread the bounded log subject through the identity-bearing and fallback sites (ADR-026 clause 3) - correction attempt 2 re-review

findings.description: Resolved. The reader-threw metadata-read-failure catch path is now a distinct, genuinely exercised site. DriveMetadataReadFailureAsync gained a readerThrows switch that sets FakeMetadataReader.Handler to throw InvalidOperationException (Result stays null, so ReadAsync's `Result ?? Handler(...)` reaches the throwing handler and the exception propagates into the processor's catch). Two new theories drive it: MetadataReaderThrowSubjectIsTheFileNameOnlyAtEveryVerbosity (path-bearing) and MetadataReaderThrowSubjectFallsBackToTheItemIdWhenNoPathIsAvailable (pathless), each pinning 'the reader threw InvalidOperationException.' so it cannot be confused with the failed-read result.
evidence: tests/ArrTags.Tests/LogRedactionTests.cs:1062-1103 (DriveMetadataReadFailureAsync readerThrows branch sets Handler to throw, does not set Result)
tests/ArrTags.Tests/ReconciliationFixtures.cs:86-95 (`Result ?? Handler(...)`; null Result guarantees the throw path)

Independent probe: reverted only the catch-path subject (line 159) to LogSubject.Create(identity.JellyfinItemId); rebuilt 0 warnings / 0 errors; LogRedactionTests failed exactly 4 cases (MetadataReaderThrowSubjectIsTheFileNameOnlyAtEveryVerbosity at Warning, Information, Debug, Trace) while the failed-read theory still passed, proving the two paths are now independently asserted. Tree restored byte-identically (sha256sum -c: OK), rebuilt, focused 143/143

findings.description: Resolved. LibraryWorkWorker.LogRetryScheduled is now driven and asserted. DriveQueueRetryAsync enqueues a connection-scoped LibraryWorkItem and uses RetryableWorkItemProcessor, which returns WorkProcessingResult.Transient (retryable), so the worker emits WorkItemRetryScheduled. WorkWorkerRetrySubjectIsTheItemIdAtEveryVerbosity filters on that event id, asserts the item-id subject on every retry record, and pins the retained '<connection|*>, <surface>' context with the connection-scoped key.
evidence: tests/ArrTags.Tests/LogRedactionTests.cs:897-926 (DriveQueueRetryAsync; connection-scoped key, 5s bounded wait for WorkItemRetryScheduled)

Independent probe: replaced the retry record's context (line 266) with LogSubject.Create(System.Guid.Empty); rebuilt 0 warnings / 0 errors; LogRedactionTests failed exactly 2 cases (WorkWorkerRetrySubjectIsTheItemIdAtEveryVerbosity at Debug and Trace). Tree restored byte-identically (sha256sum -c: OK), rebuilt, focused 143/143

findings.description: Unchanged. The identity-present-but-pathless fallback remains site-tested at the mixed discard site and at both metadata-read-failure sites (now including the reader-threw path), but not at the artwork or Radarr/Sonarr reader sites; those rely on the shared helper unit tests plus the representative site-level fallbacks. Residual risk remains low because every site passes the same `identity.MediaLocation?.PrimaryPath` argument into the same helper. No action expected or needed.

Unchanged and honest. Roughly half of the 78 theory cases run at gated-off verbosity levels and assert only record count 0 (the sentinel scan is vacuous on an empty list). This is sufficient - count 0 is the gating assertion and no output can leak - but 'at every verbosity level' should not be read as a subject assertion at every level. The correction added two gated-off retry cases that assert Assert.Empty(retries), which is likewise honest.

findings.description: New observation on the attempt-2 correction, no action required. The correction also restores bounded worker connection/surface context (implementation-reviewer IR-15.2-01) and centralizes it in DescribeWorkItem. The tests pin both context branches - a hint-derived key gives '(*, Primary)' and a connection-scoped key gives '(radarr-connection-scope, Primary)' - via the exact-substring AssertQueueContext, so dropping or changing the context fails. This is a production log-format change beyond the pure subject substitution (the item-id component also moves from the pre-task WorkItemKey N format to the D-format subject and the wrapper to parentheses), and both the worker report and changelog disclose it accurately. AssertNoSentinel still runs on the worker theories, and the context value is the non-secret connection scope (ADR-020 clause 4 allowed), so no new redaction gap is introduced.

The retry driver waits on the WorkItemRetryScheduled record with a bounded 5s poll and then stops the worker; the first retry is emitted immediately, and Assert.All tolerates more than one retry record. Two independent focused runs (including after restore) both reported 143/143.

summary: Correction attempt 2 fully closes the two concrete test-quality gaps from attempt 1 and introduces no new coverage gap or overclaim. TQ-15.2-01 (MEDIUM) is resolved: the reader-threw metadata-read-failure catch is now driven by a throwing handler with path-bearing and pathless identities and exact subject/fallback assertions, and an independent probe reverting only that catch-path subject fails exactly the 4 enabled reader-throw cases while the failed-read path still passes. TQ-15.2-02 (LOW) is resolved: the scheduled-retry record is driven by a retryable processor and its subject plus retained connection/surface context are asserted, with an independent probe failing exactly the 2 enabled retry cases. The informational items TQ-15.2-03/04/05 are unchanged and honestly noted, and the new TQ-15.2-06 records that the added worker connection/surface context assertions are exact, sensitive, and sentinel-safe. Assertions remain observable-behavior based (real production classes, doubles only at external boundaries), specific (positive exact substrings plus absence of '/', the replaced item id, and the file names), deterministic, and skip-honest. Independently reproduced counts: focused LogRedactionTests 143 passed / 0 skipped / 143 total; full default suite 1595 passed / 63 skipped / 1658 total / 0 failed (+78 / +78 / 0 new skips vs the post-15.1 1517/63/1580 baseline). No open BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW remains, so the re-review is APPROVED.
